high_level_description: This image is a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "aarushigambhir" at La Mer Beach. The post features a single photo of a person standing on a sandy beach under a clear blue sky. The individual is wearing a blue bikini top and white pants with a decorative belt featuring circular designs. They have long hair and are posing with one hand touching their head. The background includes palm trees, some greenery, and a few structures that appear to be part of a beachside area, possibly a resort or public beach facility.
